heroDescription: Understand your cycle. Experience your pregnancy with ease. Grow with your baby. Keep daily care, big questions, and unforgettable moments all in one place.
heroNoteText: Rhythm, Bud, and Embrace — with you at every new beginning.
heroTrust: 21 languages · iPhone and Android · Free basic features
heroCharacterAlt: Anacan's Rhythm, Bud, and Embrace characters
detailBenefitsTitle: What does it add to your daily life?
cycleTitle: Understand your body's rhythm. Get closer to yourself.
cycleDescription: Menstrual calendar, cycle records, symptoms, and mood diary. Get to know your body better day by day with Rhythm.
cycleIntro: Every cycle can be different. Anacan helps you see changes by keeping dates, daily feelings, and observations in one place. Take time to understand yourself, not just remember.
cycleBenefit1Text: Record the start and duration of your menstruation. Look back at previous cycles at a glance, and make approximate plans for upcoming dates.
cycleBenefit2Text: Record daily observations such as pain, energy, sleep, and mood. It becomes easier to track changes related to yourself across different periods.
cycleBenefit3Text: Learn estimated dates for ovulation and the fertile window. Calendar prediction does not measure ovulation and is not a method of protection.
cycleBenefit4Text: By recording dates and symptoms daily, you will remember more clearly the topics you want to discuss at the appointment.
cycleStep1Text: Add the first day of your last menstruation and your usual cycle length, if known. Update the information as it changes.
cycleStep2Text: Write down how you feel and your symptoms. Short, consistent notes turn into a more useful history over time.
cycleStep3Text: Look at your calendar and previous observations. Discuss your notes with your doctor if you experience persistent or severe discomfort.
pregnancyTitle: A new life is growing. You are not alone.
pregnancyDescription: Week-by-week development, daily observations, and preparation for birth. Anacan is with you on every new page of your pregnancy journey.
pregnancyIntro: A pregnancy means many firsts: the first question, the first movement, the first preparation. Anacan combines information and daily care so you can welcome each week a little more comfortably.
pregnancyBenefit1Text: View general development information and body changes corresponding to the week of pregnancy. Confirm dates with the information provided by your doctor.
pregnancyBenefit2Text: Keep symptoms, mood, and daily notes in one place. Have ready questions and a clear history for your next appointment.
pregnancyBenefit3Text: Break down preparation into small steps with a birth bag checklist, calendar, and helpful articles. Think ahead about what is important to you.
pregnancyBenefit4Text: Share your care with your partner, explore your questions with in-app information and community features. Welcome new weeks together.
pregnancyStep1Text: Enter the date of your last menstruation or the due date given by your doctor into the app. Confirm calculated dates at your medical appointment.
pregnancyStep2Text: Read weekly content, record your observations, and save your questions. Break down big questions into small daily steps.
pregnancyStep3Title: Prepare for birth at your own pace
pregnancyStep3Text: Collect your preparation lists and memories. Share responsibilities with your partner and plan next steps with your doctor.
motherhoodTitle: From the first hug to every new first.
motherhoodDescription: Feeding, sleep, diaper, and growth records. With Anacan, your baby's daily log and your memories are together.
motherhoodIntro: Daily life with a baby changes rapidly. The last feeding, the duration of sleep, a new smile — Anacan keeps these small details so there's more room for the moments you spend together.
motherhoodBenefit1Text: Record breastfeeding and bottle feeding. Easily refer back to the last feeding and daily history.
motherhoodBenefit2Text: Better understand your baby's daily rhythm by tracking sleep onset, duration, and diaper changes.
motherhoodBenefit3Text: Keep records of weight, height, and other growth metrics. Utilize the history to evaluate measurements with your baby's doctor.
motherhoodBenefit4Text: Share experiences in the community, record your mood, and make space to ask for help. Your needs are also important in the motherhood diary.
motherhoodStep1Text: Add the birth date and initial information. Use appropriate profiles and records for each baby in your family.
motherhoodStep2Text: Add feeding, sleep, and diaper records throughout the day. Tracking previous records becomes easier with shared care.
motherhoodStep3Text: Update growth data and add new moments to your monthly album. Prepare your questions for the next doctor's appointment.
partnerTitle: Care is not a one-person job.
partnerDescription: Daily support, shared plans, and joint responsibility. Find your place on this journey with Anacan's partner mode.
partnerIntro: Sometimes the biggest support is taking on a small task without being asked. Partner mode makes shared information and daily steps visible so you can share care more easily.
partnerBenefit1Text: Create your own account and join your partner using the invitation steps in the app. View shared information within their permissions.
partnerBenefit2Text: Find concrete starting points for daily help with small tasks and care ideas. Listening and sharing responsibility are key.
partnerBenefit3Text: Prepare together by viewing appointments and shared observations. No need for one person to remember everything.
partnerBenefit4Text: Consider daily care situations with preparation tests and articles. The goal is not to be perfect, but to learn together.
partnerStep1Text: Download Anacan, select the partner role, and complete the in-app steps for the invitation link.
partnerStep2Text: Listen to your partner, view shared information, and specify which tasks you will take on.
partnerStep3Text: Keep up your small daily steps. Allow for changes in the plan and discuss needs together again.
memoriesTitle: Everything you'll want to remember one day.
memoriesDescription: Keep first moments, monthly memories, and growing together with pregnancy and baby albums.
memoriesIntro: Some moments are too small, but you don't want to forget them. The first picture of pregnancy, the baby's first smile, and a new memory every month — Anacan makes space for your story alongside daily care.
memoriesBenefit1Text: Document your journey with pictures and notes as the weeks pass. Easily revisit each new stage later.
memoriesBenefit2Text: Add a picture for each month and the small details you want to remember. Build the story of growth at your own pace.
memoriesBenefit3Text: Along with a photo, preserve the feeling of that day. Write the story that is important to you in your own words.
memoriesBenefit4Text: Keep care notes and albums in the same app. Quickly return to the diary you need and the memory you love.
memoriesStep1Text: Open the album corresponding to your pregnancy or baby stage. Continue with your existing profile.
memoriesStep2Text: Add the picture and a short note about that day. A perfect shot is not necessary, it's enough for it to be meaningful to you.
memoriesStep3Text: Update the album as new months and weeks arrive. See how far you've come with the moments you've saved.
aiTitle: Unlock your big question with a conversation.
aiDescription: Explore daily questions with Dr. Anacan, understand general information, and go to your doctor's appointment more prepared.
aiIntro: It's natural to have many questions during new stages. Dr. Anacan is an AI assistant to clarify information and explore topics. Conversations with him do not replace personal diagnosis and treatment.
aiBenefit1Text: Write your general questions about periods, pregnancy, and baby care in your own language. Learn unclear terms with simple explanations.
aiBenefit2Text: Take time to understand the information by moving from one question to a new one. Confirm answers with your doctor for your personal situation.
aiBenefit3Title: Have questions ready for your appointment
aiBenefit3Text: Note down topics that arise in the conversation. Know more clearly what you want to ask at your next doctor's appointment.
aiBenefit4Text: AI answers may contain incorrect or outdated information. In an emergency, seek medical help without waiting for an AI answer.
aiStep1Text: Open the Dr. Anacan section in the app and type the general topic you want to learn about.
aiStep2Text: Re-ask about parts of the answer that are unclear. Use the conversation for general information.
aiStep3Title: Make medical decisions with your doctor
aiStep3Text: Bring your questions and observations to the appointment. Confirm diagnosis, treatment, and medication decisions with a qualified specialist.
communityDescription: Share experiences, ask questions, and connect with women going through the same stage in your own language.
communityIntro: Everyone's story is different, but some feelings are familiar. The Anacan community provides a space for conversation, questions, and daily experiences. Here, listening is as valuable as sharing.
communityBenefit1Text: See posts in your chosen language and join the conversation. Express your daily experiences more comfortably.
communityBenefit2Text: Ask a question, share an experience, and continue the conversation in the comments. Do not take someone else's experience as medical advice.
communityBenefit3Text: Connect in open and invitation-only groups. Find a communication space that suits you with messaging and group options.
communityBenefit4Text: You choose what to share. Use reporting and user management features for inappropriate content.
communityStep1Text: Open the community by selecting your preferred language and stage in the app.
communityStep2Title: Take a small step into the conversation
communityStep2Text: Read posts, ask a question, or share a detail from your own experience. Write as much as you feel comfortable with.
communityStep3Text: Browse topic groups, return to replies, and continue the conversation with mutual respect.
healthTitle: Your notes in one place. Your appointment clearer.
healthDescription: Symptoms, mood, blood pressure, and daily observations. Keep your history with Anacan and prepare for your doctor's appointment.
healthIntro: It can be difficult to remember every detail during a doctor's appointment. Daily notes show more clearly when, how, and for how long something lasted. Anacan helps you collect information; your doctor medically evaluates it.
healthBenefit1Text: Record your daily feelings and observations. Discuss changes more easily by reviewing them by date.
healthBenefit2Text: Record blood pressure and other relevant measurements. Use the values according to the correct measurement method and the plan provided by your doctor.
healthBenefit3Text: Collect your notes for the relevant period and profile in a report. Use the ready history during your appointment and whenever you want to share it.
healthBenefit4Text: Separate daily observations according to your cycle, pregnancy, and baby's profile. Easily find related information.
healthStep1Text: Select the tool that matches your stage and the observation you want to record.
healthStep2Text: Add a measurement or symptom with a date. Keep the context of that day with a short note.
healthStep3Text: Review your notes for the relevant period, write down your questions, and prepare a doctor's report if needed.
